card.line: The Holy Place was the room inside the tabernacle and later the temple, set apart for serving God and separated from the Most Holy Place by a veil.

moments.title: A veil divides the rooms
moments.text: God told Moses to hang a veil and put the ark of the Testimony behind it. The veil would separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

moments.title: Priests wear special clothes
moments.text: Aaron and his sons had to wear linen undergarments when they served in the Holy Place, so that they would not become guilty and die.

moments.title: The cloud fills the house
moments.text: When the priests came out of the Holy Place, a cloud filled the house of the LORD. The priests could not stand to serve, because the glory of the LORD filled it.

moments.title: The service is neglected
moments.text: The king said that their fathers had shut the doors of the portico and put out the lamps. They did not burn incense or present burnt offerings in the Holy Place of the God of Israel.

problems.problem: The neglect moment still says burnt offerings were presented in the Holy Place without clarifying that the altar for burnt offerings was outside and the verse refers to sanctuary service more broadly.
